decisions.auxiliary_queries: query offsets from main-step start; only main endpoint advances state
decisions.bank_law: PCG64 role=1/session=1/trajectory/channel=4; independent uniform six-knot paths at each 40 ms observation coordinate
decisions.invalid_selection: decision failure, no benign zero regret
decisions.regret: truth selected cost - minimum truly feasible cost; conditional on valid decisions
decisions.tie_selection: lowest candidate index among numerically resolved predicted-cost ties
decisions.truth_refinement: all candidates 250000/125000/62500 ns; unresolved simulator-cost separations refine at 31250/15625 ns; plateau or exhaustion retains ties

evaluation.adaptive_refinement_policy: refine cases above 1% error; last-two-resolution discrepancy envelope; stop on nondecreasing discrepancy or exhausted integer grid; retain unresolved equality
evaluation.composition: held P(h) versus P(h/2) composed twice with identical command
evaluation.held_probe_law: independent uniform two-joint draw at each of 41 observation coordinates; shared across horizons
evaluation.intervention: immutable observed q/v/w initial state for new-command and zero-command branches
evaluation.target_law: one independent uniform two-joint target per trajectory

metrics.p95: 95th percentile of two-joint Euclidean endpoint-error norms
metrics.rmse: sqrt(mean squared component error over endpoints and both joints)
